title: [FEAT] Auto-detect color theme with the terminal
body: # Motivation I have color scheme of the terminal synced to the OS theme, so Claude Code looks like this with the light terminal background unless I manually change it to light theme with `/theme`. # Proposed solution On startup, or ideally once in a while, check the color scheme of the terminal, and choose `dark` or `light` theme depending on it. Use terminal escape codes OSC 10 / OSC 11 to detect terminal color scheme. See https://github.com/sharkdp/bat/pull/2896 for inspiration.
author: shekhirin
